Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is hiring a Senior Recruiter to lead critical searches across our G&A functions.

These teams shape how Ramp grows, protects the business, and maintains a high bar as we scale. You will own searches from initial scoping through close, partnering directly with leaders across Recruiting, Risk, and other G&A functions. You will be expected to develop real fluency in each area you support, translate ambiguous business needs into clear hiring strategies, and bring an independent point of view on talent.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally strong at research, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating sensitive searches, and creating structure without slowing the business down.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across Recruiting, Risk, and other G&A functions, from intake and market mapping through offer and close.

  • Develop real fluency in the functions you support so you can identify the signals that distinguish exceptional talent beyond title, company, and tenure.

  • Partner with hiring leaders to define the hiring thesis, calibrate the bar, and translate ambiguous needs into clear search strategies and interview plans.

  • Build proactive pipelines through market research, targeted sourcing, referrals, and thoughtful engagement with passive candidates.

  • Advise leaders using market intelligence, recruiting data, and candidate feedback to challenge assumptions and improve hiring decisions.

  • Run disciplined, high-velocity processes while delivering a personal candidate experience and leading thoughtful closing strategies for competitive hires.

 

What You Need

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including significant ownership of G&A, corporate, or specialized business-function searches.

  • Experience recruiting for functions such as Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, People, or Recruiting.

  • A track record of independently leading complex or senior-level searches from initial scoping through accepted offer.

  • Strong talent judgment and research instincts. You can map a market, identify meaningful signals, and explain why someone is likely to excel at Ramp.

  • The credibility to advise senior leaders, challenge requirements, and influence hiring decisions through clear communication, market insight, and data.

  • Strong execution and closing skills, including comfort with AI-enabled recruiting workflows, ATS and funnel discipline, competing offers, and sensitive searches.

About Crossmint

Global financial rails are undergoing a once-in-a-generation transformation. Instant settlement. Programmable. Agent-first. Crossmint is the infrastructure helping companies build for that future.

We are the leading all-in-one stablecoin and wallet infrastructure platform, enabling fintechs, enterprises, and agentic platforms to integrate stablecoin rails with speed, compliance, and scale. Crossmint provides everything enterprises need to ship smart financial rails, including smart wallets, cross-chain stablecoin orchestration, on/offramps, token checkout, and more, all through a single developer-friendly API.

Trusted by more than 40,000 clients including global leaders like MoneyGram, Western Union, and Paga to nation states like the Marshall Islands, Crossmint powers stablecoin flows that move billions from cross-border remittances, global payroll, to the world's first digital UBI program.

MiCA-authorized, PSD2-licensed, and SOC2 Type II certified, Crossmint serves 150+ countries globally across 50+ blockchains. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Franklin Templeton, NYCA, First Round, and Lightspeed Faction.

We're building the infrastructure for the era of programmable finance. Join us!

Location

NYC or Miami. Hybrid office setting.

Type of employment

Full-time

Seniority

5+ years building production systems, with 3+ years focused on fraud, risk, or trust and safety.

Compensation

Base salary range: $185,000 - $220,000

Note: This range reflects base salary only. Final level, team assignment, and compensation are determined during the interview process based on experience and fit.

  • Stock options are part of every full-time offer, granted on top of the base salary range above. We want everyone here to be a genuine stakeholder in what we're building.

  • We conduct two performance reviews annually. The first addresses performance ratings, bonuses, and promotions. The second encompasses these elements along with salary adjustments reflecting inflation and market conditions.

About The Role

We are hiring our first dedicated Anti-Fraud Engineer.

Crossmint moves billions across remittances, payroll, on/offramps, card rails, and agent-initiated payments. Every one of those flows carries a fraud surface, and today the controls live inside each product. This role builds the decisioning layer that all of them use, and owns the numbers it produces.

The role has a loss line attached to it. You will know what fraud costs us, which controls moved that number, and which good customers we blocked on the way. If you want a job where the impact is arguable, this is not it.

You will report to the Engineering Manager for Identity, Compliance & Risk and work day to day with our Risk Operations analysts, Compliance, Legal, Security, and the product teams whose flows you protect. Crossmint operates under MiCA, DORA, SOC 2, and PSD2, so your controls carry both a commercial and a licensing consequence.

This is a hands-on role. You will write the code, read the data, and take the pager.

Responsibilities

Own fraud decisioning

  • Build and own the services that score and decide onboarding attempts, stablecoin transfers, on/offramp orders, and card transactions.

  • Turn analyst judgment into production rules and models, with clear thresholds, versioning, backtesting, and a fast path to roll back.

  • Build the signals those decisions depend on: device, behavior, velocity, counterparty, and graph relationships across clients and wallets.

  • Measure every decision. Own catch rate, false-positive rate, and fraud loss per product line, and publish them without being asked.

Detect and respond

  • Build detection for account takeover, mule networks, first-party fraud, synthetic identities, refund and promo abuse, and agent-initiated payment abuse.

  • Cut the time from a new fraud pattern to a live control. Same day when the pattern is clear.

  • Lead the engineering side of fraud incidents: contain the loss, find the root cause, and close the hole in the product.

  • Participate in the on-call rotation.

Give Risk Operations leverage

  • Build the tools our analysts work in: case management, queues, reason codes, and rule tuning they can do themselves.

  • Decide what we build and what we buy across device intelligence, transaction monitoring, screening, and case management, then integrate it properly.

  • Produce the evidence Compliance needs for filings, audits, and supervisory review as an output of the system rather than a manual exercise.

Stay close to the product

  • Review design documents for new products and name the fraud surface before launch, not after the first loss.

  • Work with client-facing teams when a client's own fraud problem arrives on our rails.

  • Keep current on fraud tooling, onchain tracing, and the AI-native workflows we use across engineering.

About You

Must-haves

  • 5+ years building production systems, with 3+ years focused on fraud, risk, or trust and safety.

  • A track record at a company where fraud carried a real cost: payments, card issuing or acquiring, banking, lending, marketplaces, or a crypto exchange. You can tell us which losses you cut and how you proved it.

  • Hands-on ownership of a rules engine or model-serving path in production, plus the data pipeline behind it.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one modern language. TypeScript is ideal.

  • Fluency in the metrics and the trade-offs between them: catch rate, false-positive rate, precision at threshold, and loss rate.

  • Comfort with SQL and with running your own analysis. You look at the data before you argue about it.

  • The judgment to size a control against the loss it prevents and the friction it adds.

  • Deep familiarity with current AI and agentic tools, and a view on how they change fraud work on both sides.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.

Strong plus if you have

  • Experience with stablecoins, wallet infrastructure, or blockchain payment rails, including onchain tracing and address risk.

  • Card scheme fraud experience: chargebacks, dispute and monitoring programs, 3DS, and SCA exemptions.

  • Experience with KYC/KYB onboarding abuse and synthetic identity detection.

  • Experience with commercial fraud and monitoring platforms, and a clear view of where they stop earning their price.

  • Experience as the first fraud engineer somewhere, or early in a risk function's life.

  • Direct experience with BSA/OFAC, PSD2/SCA, MiCA, DORA, or SOC 2.

How to succeed in this role

A successful Anti-Fraud Engineer will:

  • Ship a control this quarter that shows up in the loss numbers next quarter.

  • Hold both sides of every threshold: the fraud stopped and the good customer blocked.

  • Give analysts tools that remove work, rather than a queue that adds it.

  • Explain one decision to an auditor, a client, and an engineer using the same set of facts.

  • Find the fraud surface in a design document before the product ships.

This role is not a fit for someone who:

  • Wants a mature fraud program to maintain. This one is being built.

  • Tunes models and leaves the product surface to somebody else.

  • Needs a data team, an ops team, and a platform team in place before shipping anything.

Benefits

  • Extensive access to leading AI tools and subscriptions, with AI actively encouraged and integrated into daily workflows.

  • Unlimited, flexible PTO.

  • Parental Leave program.

  • Flexible work schedule.

  • Company laptop and allowance for any necessary home equipment.

  • Daily stipend for commuting to the office and/or meals.

  • Two company-paid off-sites each year.

  • Health, dental, vision, life, short-term disability (STD), and long-term disability (LTD) insurances.

  • 401(k) Plan.

Our Principles

  • Results and delivery: Ship high quality work fast.

  • Build for the long term: Build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. Use AI.

  • Extreme Ownership: Be an effective Directly Responsible Individual (DRI). Be proactive.

  • Be a team player: Be an effective and kind colleague providing credible challenge. Be present and reliable.

Talent research indicates that women are often less inclined than men to apply for a role unless they have experience in 100% of the listed skills. However, this list is only a guide. We welcome your application even if you feel you meet around 75% of the requirements. At Crossmint, we believe skills can be learned, and diversity makes us stronger.

We work to foster a respectful environment where each person can be their authentic self, free from harassment, racism, and any form of discrimination. We proudly uphold our commitment to diversity and inclusion as an equal opportunity employer, and this policy applies to all employment practices within our organization.

Please note that Crossmint never conducts AI-based interviews, and all of our processes include an initial video call with a team member. Crossmint will not request your personal identification documents or any payment at any point during your interview process. Please stay vigilant about potential fraud. If you receive an email that claims to be from Crossmint but ends with any domain other than @crossmint.com, @crossmint.io or @paella.dev, it is not from us. We own these three domains listed before, and they are the only legitimate ones.

Please let our Talent Team know if you need any assistance completing any forms, or participating in the process.

Who will be in contact with you

Our People Ops team will be joining you throughout the entirety of the interview and onboarding processes. Feel free to reach out if you need anything!

descriptions.job-033srv7:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

"At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you."

– Alicia Strait, VP of Talent, TRM Labs

The teams that keep TRM running — Strategic Finance, Legal, People, Operations — are what let us scale a mission-critical platform responsibly, at speed, in a heavily regulated space. As a Team Lead, G&A Recruiter, You’ll own TRM’s most strategic and mission-critical G&A searches while setting the standard for the G&A recruiting pod. You’ll manage your own requisitions, but your impact will extend across the team—driving consistency, raising the bar, and helping the pod operate as a tight, high-performing unit. As the day-to-day peer leader closest to the work, you’ll take meaningful operating overhead off the manager’s plate and help the team move with greater speed and precision.

Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of hires across TRM's G&A organization as well as how successfully you mentor your teammates, and how well the pod around you performs.

How this role differs from a Senior or Staff G&A Recruiter: A Senior/Staff recruiter owns their searches exceptionally well. As Team Lead, you own your searches and the operating rhythm, unblocking, experimentation, and outcomes of the whole G&A pod. You’ll set the example for more junior recruiters on what exceptional partnership with executive stakeholders looks like.

The impact you'll have:

Leading the pod:

  • Run executive level G&A hiring syncs, driving the cadence, priorities, and follow-through for the team and its hiring managers.

  • Represent the G&A pod in headcount and workforce-planning discussions with Talent leadership, bringing the on-the-ground view from being closest to the department leads.

  • Bubble up what's happening across the G&A recruiting team — risks, wins, market signals, and blockers — so the manager and VP stay informed.

  • Drive solutioning and experimentation with the team, testing new sourcing angles, processes, and ideas and unblocking searches when they stall.

  • Help the team execute on retros and decision docs, turning what you learn into durable improvements.

  • Shape and roll out new processes and changes to the pod: when the team adopts a new way of working, much of it comes from you.

Owning your own searches:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for senior and specialized G&A searches across Strategic Finance, Legal, People, Operations, and other corporate functions.

  • Act as a strategic talent partner to executive stakeholders; advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, hiring strategy, and close approach.

  • Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional G&A talent from high-growth technology, fintech, crypto, public sector, and financial services environments.

  • Develop deep market maps for priority searches that include competitive talent, high-performing corporate functions, and referral-driven networks.

  • Create an exceptional candidate experience for senior and specialized talent, so every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles.

  • Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time.

  • Serve as a craft leader on the Talent team, raising the bar for sourcing, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, and strategic search execution.

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience, with 7+ years of experience owning senior G&A searches in high-growth technology companies.

  • Experience leading or setting direction for a recruiting pod including running hiring syncs, unblocking other recruiters' searches, and driving team experimentation — whether or not you've formally managed people.

  • A track record of taking operating overhead off a manager's plate: owning team cadence, process rollouts, retros, and decision docs so the group runs as a tight unit.

  • Proven success hiring senior and specialized talent across Strategic Finance, Legal, People, Operations, and other corporate functions.

  • Strong search fundamentals including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, confidential search management, and senior-level closing.

  • The ability to quickly understand complex corporate roles across finance, legal, compliance, people, operations, and business-critical leadership.

  • Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, and pipeline quality, and translate them into action for yourself and the team.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, building trust, influencing senior leaders, pushing back thoughtfully, and operating as a strategic advisor throughout the process.

  • Excellent written and verbal executive presence, including synthesizing market insight, candidate tradeoffs, and search progress clearly for executive audiences.

  • High ownership, persistence, and judgment in navigating ambiguous, confidential, business-critical searches.

  • A demonstrated ability to balance speed with quality while holding a high talent bar for G&A hiring.

About the team:

  • Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates.

  • We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together.

  • We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting.

  • We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration.

  • Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review.

  • Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen.

  • Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled.

    Our Onboarding Process:

    • Within your first 30 days, you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions.

    • Within your first 60 days, you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds.

    • Within your first 90 days, you’ll have made 2–3 hires.

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $172,000 - $196,000.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft.   • Own security's relationship with auditors, regulators, and compliance frameworks including SOC 2 Type II, DORA, and MiCA-related security requirements.

  • Lead audit preparation cycles: scope definition, evidence readiness, control documentation, and auditor-facing communication.

  • Maintain audit-ready posture year-round, not as a sprint before each audit window.

  • Partner with the Compliance function to ensure security controls satisfy both regulatory requirements and practical risk management objectives.

Third-Party and Vendor Risk

  • Own the security review process for new vendors, integrations, and third-party relationships.

  • Manage relationships with external security partners including our third-party audit firms and 24/7 incident response provider.

  • Define and oversee our external penetration testing and security assessment program.

Team and Stakeholder Leadership

  • Manage and develop the Senior DevSecOps Engineer, with the expectation of growing the security team over time.

  • Serve as the internal authority on security for Engineering, Product, Compliance, Legal, and People Ops.

  • Drive security awareness and culture across the company without creating friction that slows down product teams.

  • Communicate risk clearly to non-technical leadership, translating technical realities into business decisions.

About Renegade
 
We're building the first dark pool built natively for onchain markets.

Renegade is an onchain dark pool, a private exchange for institutional crypto trading, fully onchain with no trusted intermediaries. In TradFi, dark pools account for roughly 40% of US equities volume. That entire layer of market structure barely exists in crypto.

Renegade brings that infrastructure to DeFi. We match orders at the midpoint of the Binance bid-ask spread, without moving the market, without leaking information, and without leaving the chain. Funds, solvers, and market makers that integrate with Renegade get better price execution, with savings on spreads, market impact, and fees.
 
Since launch on Arbitrum and Base, Renegade has processed $336M in all-time trading volume with $100M in daily order flow.
 
We've been live since late 2024, are well-funded by leading investors. We are a lean high-caliber team that works in person in San Francisco. 
 
You can see the work directly here:
  • Docs https://docs.renegade.fi/
  • Code https://github.com/renegade-fi/renegade

Translate between customers and engineering, share customer signal back to the dev team to inform new product features and respond to the evolving demands of onchain markets
 
Source and grow pipeline

Polymarket is the world’s largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized “house,” Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast – both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

Polymarket is looking for a pragmatic full-stack engineer to join our US Exchange team. You'll build the critical internal systems that power our CFTC-regulated exchange operations—from payment reconciliation and transaction processing to operational dashboards and compliance tooling.

This is a high-impact role where you'll work directly with operations teams, build systems that handle real money at scale, and help establish the technical foundation for our growing US exchange business. If you enjoy solving complex problems in fintech, building tools that people actually use every day, and shipping code that matters, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Build tools for US exchange operations. Create systems that help control desk operators, supervisors, and compliance teams manage high-volume payment processing and reconciliation workflows.

  • Ship production features regularly. Launch improvements and fixes frequently in a fast-paced, regulated environment where reliability matters.

  • Work across the full stack. Build frontend interfaces for operational dashboards and backend APIs for transaction processing, reconciliation, and payment provider integrations and other control desk operations.

  • Collaborate with internal teams. Partner closely with operations, compliance, and product to understand workflows, gather feedback, and iterate quickly on tooling.

  • Design for scale and compliance. Build systems that handle thousands of daily transactions while maintaining audit trails and meeting CFTC regulatory requirements.

  • Contribute to technical decisions. Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and help establish best practices for the team.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3-7 years of professional software development experience

  • Strong full-stack web development skills with TypeScript. Strong backend experience with Go.

  • Solid experience with React and Node.js (Next.js experience is a plus)

  • Experience building data-heavy applications or internal tools

  • Ability to work with external APIs and integrate third-party services

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills—you work well with non-technical stakeholders

  • Bias for action—comfortable shipping iteratively and refining based on user feedback

  • Builder's mindset—you take pride in creating tools that solve real operational problems

  • (Plus) Experience with MongoDB

  • (Plus) Background in fintech, payments, reconciliation systems, or regulated environments

  • (Plus) Familiarity with customer service or operations tooling

  • (Plus) Understanding of financial data modeling and audit requirements

  • (Plus) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent


Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

Pay Transparency

暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。

オープンでフェアな社会を実現する

Mission

ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる

Values

何事にも真摯に取り組み、関わるすべての人を尊重する。
率直に意見し、言行に責任をもち、誠実であることを誇る。

【 Challenge 】
あらゆるチャンスを素早く捉え、失敗を恐れず、自らチャレンジし続ける。

【 One team 】
仲間を信じ、仲間と取り組み、仲間と共に成長する。

  • 2021年、ミクシィとセレスより75億円の資金調達を発表しました。

【リテールシステム部】ソフトウェアエンジニア

雇用形態

正社員

ビットバンクは「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに、暗号資産取引所サービスを提供しています。

同上
